description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values across several language-family categories for four model/condition combinations, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories (left to right): IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, a blank/greyed tick region, Semitic, and Uralic; there is no explicit x-axis label, and the categories are presented in this fixed order rather than sorted by bar height. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and above 40 to accommodate error bars). Each category shows four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: mBERT-targ (light blue), XLM-targ (dark blue), mBERT-permute (light green), and XLM-permute (dark green), each with a vertical error bar. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic ~22 (mBERT-targ), ~15 (XLM-targ), ~6 (mBERT-permute), ~5 (XLM-permute); IE-Germanic ~13, ~12, ~8, ~9; IE-Indic ~4, ~5, ~18, ~16; IE-Romance ~15, ~12, ~3, ~2–3; IE-Slavic ~14, ~11, ~9, ~8; IE-other ~14, ~11, ~5, ~5; Semitic ~10, ~10–11, ~9, ~9; Uralic ~28–29, ~21, ~1–2, ~1. The error bars vary in length across bars, with several extending notably above and/or below the bar tops (and in some cases below 0), and no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of the greyed x-axis region between IE-other and Semitic.
